title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows
summary: The briefing needs a licensing correction: Microsoft documents Work IQ consumption billing with Copilot Credits, so the model should not be marked unpublished. The roadmap facts and both navigation paths are supported; the separate Copilot Studio confirmation setting should be qualified as standard-harness functionality.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let Work IQ agents and agent flows pause for human input or approval before continuing.
claims.quote: Work IQ: Human in the loop; Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Work IQ and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) as the products.
claims.quote: "products": ["Work IQ", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.claim: The feature is in development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) is listed, and sovereign clouds are not listed.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Web is the listed platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: General availability is targeted for January 2027.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "January CY2027"

claims.claim: The roadmap shows a preview for November 2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap description is the only published detail specific to this human-in-the-loop capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human" "approval" "flows"; Work IQ human in the loop agents agent flows approval policy default licensing timeout approver November 2026. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio, Policy governance for Work IQ MCP, and Work IQ API overview; no feature-specific implementation found.

claims.claim: The default state of the human-in-the-loop capability is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout approver identity audit default licensing. Read the roadmap, Work IQ in Copilot Studio, Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and Work IQ API overview; none states this capability's default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown and not published.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to consumption. Replace the unqualified 'Not published' and 'Not yet published' licensing statements, including the cost rationale, with: 'Work IQ uses consumption billing with Copilot Credits; any additional charge specific to pauses or approvals is not yet published.' Keep cost variable. The cited Work IQ page states the platform billing rule.

claims.where: front matter: cost and licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ in Copilot Studio uses consumption billing with Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Work IQ in Copilot Studio is powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, which uses Copilot Credits for usage-based billing.

claims.claim: Whether pauses or approvals add a feature-specific charge is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop agents agent flows approval policy default licensing timeout approver November 2026. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Work IQ API overview; they document Copilot Credits but no pause or approval surcharge.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether makers configure this pause, administrators enforce it, or both.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop tenant approval policy admin center Graph API. Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP, Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Work IQ API overview; no configuration or enforcement mechanism for this feature was found.

claims.claim: The place where approvers respond for this capability is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop agents agent flows approval policy default licensing timeout approver November 2026. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Work IQ API overview; neither describes an approver response surface for this capability.

claims.claim: What data this capability displays in approval requests is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout approver identity audit default licensing. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio, Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and Work IQ API overview; no approval-request display specification was found.

claims.claim: How this capability verifies and records approver identity is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout approver identity audit default licensing. Opened Work IQ API overview and Policy governance for Work IQ MCP; their request authentication rules do not describe this capability's approver verification or recording.

claims.claim: Timeout behaviour for this capability is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop approval timeout approver identity audit default licensing. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Work IQ API overview; no human-approval timeout is described. Results about Agent Framework and Foundry concern different mechanisms.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio separately offers a maker-configured, per-tool confirmation setting.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.
claims.fix: Replace 'Copilot Studio already has a separate capability to require human approval for tool calls' with 'Copilot Studio separately documents a per-tool end-user confirmation setting for agents using the standard harness.' Change controls[1].note to 'Maker-side, per tool, for agents using the standard harness.' Keep the relationship to the planned Work IQ capability an open question.

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP tenant policy is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API or script equivalent for switching Work IQ MCP tenant policy on or off is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ MCP policy Microsoft Graph API PowerShell enable disable tenant policy; "Work IQ" "policy" "graph.microsoft.com/beta". Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP and Work IQ API overview; no policy-toggle endpoint or command found.

claims.claim: The MCP policy article states that mutation operations, including sending email, are not allowed by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio page instead states that write operations are on by default.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.claim: Makers configure tool confirmation at Tools > tool > Details > Additional details > Ask the end user before running.
claims.quote: Go to the Tools page for your agent, and select the tool from the list of tools. ... Details ... Additional details ... Ask the end user before running: In the end user chat experience, ask the agent for confirmation before running the tool.

claims.claim: An API or script equivalent for the per-tool Ask the end user before running setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Ask the end user before running" "API" "Dataverse"; Copilot Studio tool confirmation setting botcomponent Web API requires user confirmation. Opened Add tools to custom agents; results provided no equivalent call for this setting.

claims.claim: A tenant human-in-the-loop policy for Work IQ agents and agent flows is not documented in either the UI or API.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ human in the loop tenant approval policy admin center Graph API. Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP, Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Work IQ API overview; no tenant human-in-the-loop policy path or endpoint found.

claims.claim: No central policy requiring Copilot Studio's per-tool confirmation setting was found as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "approval" "central policy"; Copilot Studio Ask the end user before running tool configuration API Dataverse central policy approval. Opened Add tools to custom agents; no central enforcement policy for that setting found.

controlChecks.governs: Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant
Whether an agent asks the user before running a tool
segments: Ask the end user before running
